# Happy Beck

Happy Beck is a bakery and restaurant located at Langstrasse 120 in Zürich, Switzerland. It has been open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, since 2006.

## Information

- **Website:** https://happybeck.ch/
- **Address:** Langstrasse 120, 8004 Zürich, Switzerland
- **Phone:** +41432439780
- **Email:** info@happybeck.ch
- **Opening Hours:** 24/7 (Open 24 hours)

## Offerings

- Fresh Sandwiches
- Breakfast
- Pizza and hot dishes
- Homemade pastry (Pâtisserie)
